title: Local derived isomorphisms on a weakly contractible affine
statement: For a scheme X and any commutative coefficient ring B in the coefficient universe, let U be an affine object of its coefficient-sized pro-etale model. Assume [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons] AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible(X,U): every epimorphism of set sheaves on the actual slice is surjective on the slice terminal object. Let L and N be any two derived module objects over the constant B-ring on the model. Suppose some covering sieve S on U has the property that for each V to U in S the actual-slice restrictions of L and N to V are isomorphic. Then their actual-slice restrictions to U are isomorphic. No boundedness, finite-type cohomology, Tor amplitude, etale descent, connectedness, or Noetherianity is assumed.

proof.text: Undo AsSmall. Use the quasi-compact-cover condition and affineness to refine the covering sieve by finitely many affine pro-etale objects. Form their finite coproduct, which is a quasi-compact surjective weakly etale cover.

source.place: Tag 09C6, weakly contractible local trivialization step; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: On the actual coefficient-sized slice, the covering map of representables is an epimorphism. Apply the given surjectivity at the terminal object to its identity section. Subcanonicity and Yoneda give a section of the coproduct cover. Pulling the coproduct components back along this section gives a finite disjoint cover of U contained in the original sieve; transport it back through AsSmall.

source.place: Tag 09C6, weakly contractible local trivialization step; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: Apply the ringed derived disjoint-cover gluing theorem to the finite disjoint refinement and the supplied isomorphism on each member. It applies directly to the actual slice restrictions and also handles the empty cover.

theorem coefficient_weaklyContractible_local_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B]
    (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (hU : IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
      U).left)
    (hweak : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (L N : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (hlocal : ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X U ∧
      ∀ (V : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
        Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
            L ≅ (adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
            N)) :
    Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) U).obj L ≅
      (adicResidueRestriction
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) U).obj
        N)
